summary: 12 of 26 sub-steps present. Strong on the bank-exchange network (B1-B4 all present), the label telescoping and loss ratios (L3, L5), the rank-saving inequality and exponent bound (R1, R4), the matrix-shear elimination, triangular cost and interchange count (M1, M3, M4), and the row-sum truncation (S5). Absent: the residual table and side-edge residual (L1, L2), the orthonormal-basis mechanism (L4), the whole phase-interface derivation (P1-P4, where only the conclusion and the Z-repair of the exceptional pair appear), the numerical deficits eta_b and eta_c (R2, R3), the prime choice for the shear (M2), and the guard-width derivation (S1-S4, where S3.5 only asserts the final o(p) bound).
